# Borr Drilling Limited Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results


Wed, Nov 18, 2026 22:45 CET[Report this content](https://news.cision.com/_editorial/Contact?url=https%3a%2f%2fnews.cision.com%2fborr-drilling-limited%2fr%2fborr-drilling-limited-announces-third-quarter-2026-results%2cc4426619)


**Hamilton, Bermuda, November 18, 2026** - Borr Drilling Limited (NYSE and OSE: BORR) (“Borr”, “Borr Drilling” or the “Company”) announces unaudited results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.


**Highlights**


- Third Quarter total operating revenues of $263.1 million, an increase of $30.8 million or 13% compared to the second quarter of 2026.


- Third Quarter net loss of $38.7 million, a decrease in net loss of $202.7 million compared to the second quarter of 2026, primarily due to the $176.3 million debt extinguishment charge recognized in the prior quarter in connection with the refinancing of the Company’s senior secured notes due 2028 and 2030 and convertible bonds due 2028.


- Third Quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $78.9 million, an increase of $35.1 million or 80% compared to the second quarter of 2026.


- Year-to-date 2026, the Company has been awarded 30 contract commitments, representing approximately 6,300 days and $810 million of Dayrate Equivalent Backlog.


**Subsequent events**


On October 24, 2026, an incident occurred with the Prospector 5 rig offshore Gabon, where the rig sank and subsequently has been declared a total loss. The rig’s insured value is $200 million, with the insurance


payment due date set for November 24, 2026. Additionally, we carry comprehensive third-party liability insurance, which includes coverage related to wreck removal and pollution. We continue to assess the financial impact of the Prospector 5 incident on the Company.


**Chief Executive Officer Bruno Morand commented:**


"Following the incident involving the Prospector 5 offshore Gabon, which the Company first announced on October 25, 2026, we continue to work closely with our customer BW Energy, the relevant authorities and other stakeholders in the ongoing response efforts. Our thoughts remain with our colleagues and their families affected by this incident, and their wellbeing continues to be our highest priority.


Moving to our performance for the third quarter of 2026, our operations resulted in technical utilization of 98.0% and economic utilization of 97.3%. Revenues for the period were $263.1 million, with an average of 22.9 operating rigs. Third-quarter Adjusted EBITDA was $78.9 million, a quarter-on-quarter increase of $35.1 million consistent with our expectations. This improvement reflects higher revenues, following an elevated number of rig transitions during the second quarter, and the non-recurrence of a credit loss provision recorded in the prior period. We currently anticipate Q4 Adjusted EBITDA performance to be broadly in line with Q3, despite the Prospector 5 impact.


Turning to the market, since our last quarterly report, we have secured nine contract commitments in key geographies outside the Middle East. These include an award to deploy the previously idle rig Hild offshore Nigeria, strengthening our presence in this growing region. The nine commitments added approximately $269 million in backlog and represent more than 1,950 days of additional firm work, bringing our contract coverage for 2026 and 2027 to 79% and 52%, respectively.


We are also seeing encouraging signs for shallow-water activity, with an increasing number of opportunities in Southeast Asia and West Africa in particular. Recent market developments reflect the continued recovery in marketed utilization for modern jack-ups, which now stands at approximately 93%, compared to around 90% nine months ago, despite persistent disruptions in the Middle East.


Based on current forward coverage, we anticipate full-year 2027 Adjusted EBITDA to be broadly in line with full-year 2026, with expectations for Q1 2027 to be sequentially lower and a strong ramp-up in Q4. The Company’s strong liquidity position provides the financial flexibility to capitalize on opportunities as the market recovers. For now, our near-term priority remains maximizing fleet utilization, while maintaining a disciplined approach to longer-term commitments to create sustainable shareholder value.”

**About Borr Drilling Limited**


Borr Drilling Limited is an international drilling contractor incorporated in Bermuda in 2016 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange since July 31, 2019 and on Euronext Oslo Børs since May 21, 2026 under the ticker "BORR." The Company owns and operates jack-up rigs of modern and high specification designs and provides services focused on the shallow-water segment to the offshore oil and gas industry worldwide. Please visit our website at www.borrdrilling.com.
